name: Stampede 50k Skate
description: Fun race! First half in 6 minute pace, but couldn’t negative split. Gonna blame it on whatever is going on with my lungs this week. Still figuring out how to take calories without hands. First race I didn’t fall in! There were some close calls with the steep windy descent snow berm buildups in the second lap. Exactly 50th percentile for men - these people were freaking fast
